Question: Which product category (English name) sold the most items in delivered orders that got a 5-star review?
text:
SELECT pt.product_category_name_english, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND r.review_score = 5
GROUP BY pt.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY item_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

This returns the English product category that sold the most items in orders that were delivered and received a 5‑star review.
